author: cms-tau-pog
body:
## PR validation

This is a small "fix", adding some missing Truth Graph associators to the HLT validation sequence.

We add some missing Truth Graph producers and PFClusters associators to the chain.

Based on work by @elenavernazza & @dmjwentworth.

Tagging also @felicepantaleo, @waredjeb

## PR validation

Setup:
```bash
source /cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/cmsset_default.sh
export SCRAM_ARCH="el9_amd64_gcc14"
mkdir -p ~/test && cd ~/test
cmsrel CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300 -n CMSSW_20_1_X_fixvalid
cd CMSSW_20_1_X_fixvalid/src/ && cmsenv
git cms-checkout-topic -u cms-tau-pog:fix_HLT_TruthGraph_Validation_CMSSW_20_1_X

scram build -j8
scram build code-checks
scram build code-format
```

Workflow that contains the HLT sequence runs without fail: 
```
runTheMatrix.py -l 38445.0 -w upgrade -j 10 --nEvents 10 
```

We have tested it more directly with the new validation workflow for taus where we are implementing the Truth Graph (WIP), see https://github.com/cms-tau-pog/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_LowLevelTauValidation/Validation/RecoTau/python/hltTruthGraphTauValidation_cff.py

where we have to add `SimGeneral/TruthGraphAssociatorProducers/customiseTruthGraphAssociators.customiseTruthHltValidation` to `--customise`:
```
cmsDriver.py  TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi  -s GEN,SIM -n 10 --conditions auto:phase2_realistic_T35 --beamspot DBrealisticHLLHC --datatier GEN-SIM --eventcontent FEVTDEBUG --geometry ExtendedRun4D128 --era Phase2C26I13M9 --relval 9000,100 

cmsDriver.py step2  -s DIGI:pdigi_valid,L1TrackTrigger,L1,L1P2GT,DIGI2RAW,HLT:@relvalRun4,VALIDATION:@hltValidation --conditions auto:phase2_realistic_T35 --datatier DQMIO -n 10 --eventcontent DQMIO --geometry ExtendedRun4D128 --era Phase2C26I13M9 --customise SLHCUpgradeSimulations/Configuration/aging.customise_aging_1000,SimGeneral/TruthGraphAssociatorProducers/customiseTruthGraphAssociators.customiseTruthHltValidation --filein file:TenTau_Pt10to500_Eta3p1_pythia8_cfi_GEN_SIM.root --fileout file:step2.root

cmsDriver.py step3  -s HARVESTING:@hltValidation --conditions auto:phase2_realistic_T35 --mc  --geometry ExtendedRun4D128 --scenario pp --filetype DQM --era Phase2C26I13M9 -n 100 --filein file:step2.root
```

Draft because we're double checking the input tag of the ECAL clusters.
